opis:
Hi,

Your post lines up with what the two of us do. We are a two person programming team and cover both the Python backend and the React frontend, so you would not need to coordinate two separate hires.

Native level English is no issue on our end, so working directly with your US team is fine.

For an ongoing arrangement I would propose 6000 PLN per month, with the first 7 days as a trial so you can see how we fit before committing longer term.

What is the product you are building? The stack is clear from the post, but a bit of context would help me say more about where we would be most useful.

Ksawier
